mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital flows shift toward risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face demand headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending contracts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) reflects supply chain disruptions, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as manufacturing output falls.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 275.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.0.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth above 19000 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 19000) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 19000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weak employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth weakens and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 260.0) maintains accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as risk appetite increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL remains below 260.0.
